summary: Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a Credit Agreement Amendment (Third Amendment) in connection with a previously announced merger. The amendment adjusts the Change of Control definition so the merger does not trigger default, extends the maturity date five years post-closing, increases revolving commitments from $200M to $250M, expands the borrowing base, and permits qualified securitizations. The amendment is contingent upon merger consummation and terminates if the Merger Agreement is terminated. The filing facilitates a going-private transaction, but is not itself a special-situation event; it is a supporting financing amendment.
